characters.name: Gabriel John Utterson
characters.description: London lawyer; friend, trustee and confidant of Dr. Henry Jekyll; central investigator of the Hyde/Jekyll mystery.

characters.name: Richard Enfield
characters.description: Distant kinsman and Sunday-walking friend of Mr. Utterson; man about town who relates the story of the door and the trampling incident.

characters.name: Dr. Henry Jekyll
characters.description: Prominent physician and scientist; friend of Utterson and Lanyon; author of the will and central figure of the narrative confession.

characters.name: Edward Hyde
characters.description: Violent, repulsive man connected to Dr. Jekyll by will and conduct; perpetrator of the Carew murder and key figure in Jekyll’s experiments.

characters.name: Dr. Hastie Lanyon
characters.description: Physician, old friend and former colleague of Jekyll and Utterson; eyewitness to a shocking transformation and author of a sealed narrative.

characters.name: Sir Danvers Carew
characters.description: Elderly, respected gentleman and Member of Parliament who is brutally murdered; victim in the Carew murder case.

characters.name: Poole
characters.description: Long-serving, solemn butler and head servant in Dr. Jekyll’s household; brings concerns about the cabinet and helps force the door.

characters.name: Mr. Guest
characters.description: Mr. Utterson’s head clerk; skilled handwriting analyst who compares Jekyll’s and Hyde’s writing.

characters.name: Inspector Newcomen
characters.description: Scotland Yard inspector investigating the murder of Sir Danvers Carew and searching Mr. Hyde’s rooms.

characters.name: Bradshaw
characters.description: Footman in Dr. Jekyll’s household; summoned to take post at the laboratory door during the forced entry.

characters.name: maid servant (witness to Carew murder)
characters.description: Unnamed maid servant living alone who witnesses the murder of Sir Danvers Carew and reports the events to police and others.

characters.name: the child (girl trampled by Hyde)
characters.description: A young girl (about eight or ten) who is trampled and left screaming in Enfield’s recounted incident.

characters.name: the Sawbones (apothecary present at child incident)
characters.description: The apothecary/doctor called for the injured child in Enfield’s tale; described as an Edinburgh-accented, unemotional 'Sawbones'.

characters.name: locksmith (called by Dr. Lanyon)
characters.description: Tradesman summoned by Dr. Lanyon to force the strong door of Jekyll’s cabinet; helps remove the specified drawer.

characters.name: carpenter (called by Dr. Lanyon)
characters.description: Tradesman engaged alongside the locksmith to assist in forcing the door of the cabinet.

characters.name: housekeeper (Hyde’s, ivory-faced woman)
characters.description: Hyde’s housekeeper at the Soho rooms; described as an ivory-faced, silvery-haired old woman who answers Hyde’s lodgings.

characters.name: housemaid (Jekyll household)
characters.description: Housemaid in Dr. Jekyll’s household who reacts hysterically when servants gather in the hall.

characters.name: knife-boy
characters.description: Young servant in Jekyll’s household who is asked by Poole to fetch a candle during the forced entry.

characters.name: the waiter (Portland Street hotel)
characters.description: Attendant at the Portland Street inn where Hyde/Hyde’s agent composes letters; visibly intimidated by the visitor.

characters.name: hansom/cab driver
characters.description: Driver of a hansom/cab encountered when Hyde/Jekyll moves about the city; reacts to the visitor’s appearance.
